entities.summary: Vladimir Ivanovich Voronkov is a Russian foreign service officer who, since 2011, has served as Russia's Permanent Representative to International Organizations in Vienna. In June 2017, the United Nations named Voronkov as the first Under-Secretary-General for the new United Nations Office of Counter-Terrorism (UNOCT).
